phase: Phase 2 — Find Tyre by Vehicle UI
run_by: main_agent (direct-URL Playwright walkthrough, bypassing auth gate which was found unrelated to Phase 2)
summary: Phase 2 fully verified end-to-end. 9/9 UI scenarios PASS (including the diff-size case that surfaced a real Phase-1 bug — blank Variant / Year cells were excluded from distinct results, blocking any row whose source cell was blank. Fixed by adding a BLANK_SENTINEL sentinel in backend + UI, preserving the user directive #17 rule that missing values must not be invented). Backend regression 4/4 PASS. 450 OEM records untouched.

S1_wizard_direct_url.note: GET /vehicle-search paints wizard + search box + 5 step rows (only Category enabled).

S2_category_uncategorised.note: Category picker shows all 14 categories including Uncategorised with '172 rows' badge.

S4_model_creta_electric.note: Model picker cascades to CRETA Electric.

S5_result_same_size_215_60_R17.note: Hyundai CRETA Electric 42 kWh 2025-present result screen renders front=rear=215/60 R17 with 'Same OEM tyre size for front and rear' banner and green OEM VERIFIED badge.

S6_details_expander.note: Toggle reveals OEM Evidence, OEM Source (linkable), Source Pass, Verification. Toggle collapses again.

S7_check_stock_placeholder.note: Check Available Tyres navigates to /vehicle-search/stock-placeholder with 'Inventory matching arrives in Phase 3' headline echoing selected vehicle + OEM sizes.

S8_back_navigation.note: stock-placeholder-back → oem-result-back returns to wizard with header visible.

S9_diff_size_honda_qc1.note: Category → Electric Scooter → Make → Honda → Model → QC1 → Variant '(not specified)' → Year → Current India model. FRONT 90/90-12 and REAR 90/100-10 shown separately with the yellow diff-size banner.

bugs_found_and_fixed_in_this_iteration.title: Rows whose Variant / Year cell is blank in the source Excel were unreachable in the wizard
bugs_found_and_fixed_in_this_iteration.root_cause: backend/oem_router.py::_distinct filtered out None/empty values for all non-category fields, so /api/oem/variants for Honda QC1 (whose Variant cell is empty in the source Excel per user directive #17) returned []. This locked the wizard because the user could not advance past the Variant step.
bugs_found_and_fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Added BLANK_SENTINEL='__blank__' constant in oem_utils.py. _distinct now preserves the blank case as the sentinel string; _exact translates the sentinel to {$or:[{field:None},{field:''}]}. Frontend renders the sentinel as '(not specified)' via oemDisplayLabel(); the raw sentinel is stored in state and passed back to the API verbatim, preserving user directive #17 (no invented values).

improvements_this_iteration.title: runQuickSearch now issues per-model /fitments lookups in Promise.all instead of sequentially (up to 8 in parallel).
